body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but how these gains relate to inference-time decoding and search remains unclear. Does RL create reasoning the base model lacks, or shift the rollout distribution toward trajectories it can already reach but rarely samples? We study this behaviorally with a Unified Decoding Framework (UDF), which expresses token-level sampling, beam-like search, tree search, and sequence-level resampling as executable policies over a shared budgeted operating space, scored post hoc with pass@k, self-consistency, best-of-N, and first-finish success. Using paired Base/RL checkpoints from SimpleRL-Zoo, we ask whether an RL default-policy curve can be approximated by a structured path of Base operating points. On Math500, AIME, GPQA, and IFEval, the pass@k recovery path follows a Budgeted Operating-Point Transition Rule (BOPTR), NBase αNRL^β, with benchmark-conditioned exponents. On Qwen2.5-7B, BOPTR gives the lowest transfer error among the non-oracle rules we test, 3.41 pp (95% CI [2.32, 5.53]); a three-seed replication gives 3.07 ± 0.39 pp. The rule extends to ten models across four families (3.28 to 4.87 pp on checkpoints added after fitting), to four benchmarks it was never fitted on (5.03 pp vs. 4.44 pp in fit), and holds without an RL checkpoint for the target model (4.19 pp) or without RL supervision of any kind (5.08 pp). These results support a qualified internalized-search reading: under the recipe we test, much of the measured RL gain corresponds to a change in sampling efficiency toward operating points the base model can already reach under search. We treat the scaling patterns as descriptive of this recipe and cohort, report where they break down, and use UDF and BOPTR as behavioral diagnostics rather than evidence of parameter-level equivalence.
summaryZh: 本文深入探讨了强化学习（RLVR）在提升语言模型推理能力中的作用机制。研究通过统一解码框架（UDF）分析发现，RL带来的性能提升很大程度上归因于采样效率的优化，即模型在搜索过程中更有效地触达了其基础能力范围内的最优路径。作者提出了预算操作点转换规则（BOPTR），通过数学建模描述了从基础模型到RL模型的性能演变规律。该研究在多个基准测试中验证了其结论的普适性，为理解推理模型训练提供了新的行为诊断视角。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究通过统一解码框架揭示了强化学习推理增益的本质，对理解模型推理能力提升机制具有重要学术价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习，用于引导模型生成正确的推理步骤。
一种将多种搜索策略（如束搜索、树搜索）统一为可执行策略的分析框架。
预算操作点转换规则，用于量化描述模型在不同计算预算下的性能表现。
推理阶段的解码策略，决定了模型如何从概率分布中采样生成序列。
衡量模型在k次尝试中至少有一次成功的概率，常用于评估代码与推理任务。
